## Lattices

### `fs.contract`

What every fsspec filesystem promises. copy, get, put, pipe and open are the shared abstract tests in fsspec/tests/abstract. find and rm_list come from the AbstractFileSystem docstrings: find returns only files under the path, to maxdepth, and rm takes a str or a list of str.
